intuition.title: Study context: One aqueous route and separate analytical branches
intuition.text: The quantified TAE method mixes 32 nmol TBA and 125 nmol lead acetate then injects 65 nmol sulfur feed in room-temperature open air. Water is a reported alternative with unresolved final volume. TEM drying, CD dilution and ultracentrifugation belong to characterization.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 1, aqueous synthesis and Scheme 1; SI PDF p. 1, Synthesis of PbS Quantum Dots Using Thrombin-Binding Aptamer

intuition.title: Study context: Sulfur-reagent source conflict
intuition.text: Main p.1 explicitly names sodium sulfide; SI p.S1 prints sodium sulfate (Na2S), while SI p.S3 specifies S2−. The SI name/formula conflict is preserved, not silently corrected. Na2S indexes the printed formula and main identity, without resolving the inconsistent SI name or hydration.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 1, aqueous synthesis and Scheme 1; SI PDF p. 1, Synthesis of PbS Quantum Dots Using Thrombin-Binding Aptamer; SI PDF p. 3, nominal synthesis description

intuition.title: Study context: Measured and assumed dimensions
intuition.text: TEM typical/majority 3–6 nm has no formal statistical analysis. The uniform 5 nm diameter is assumed only to estimate 430/860 nM particle concentrations. No lattice refinement or measured coordinates are supplied.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 1, aqueous synthesis and Scheme 1; SI PDF p. 1, Synthesis of PbS Quantum Dots Using Thrombin-Binding Aptamer; SI PDF p. 2, Figure S1

intuition.title: Study context: Optical sensing interpretation
intuition.text: The authors attribute selective photobleaching to charge transfer in an aptamer/protein complex; protein absorption does not overlap QD near-infrared emission. Quadruplex and binding cartoons are interpreted conformations, not measured atomic models.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 1–2, Scheme 1, Figures 1–2 and mechanistic discussion; SI PDF p. 2–4, Figures S3–S6

bindings.source_locator: SI PDF p. 2–3, Figure S3 and circular dichroism method
bindings.caption: Prepare free TBA samples with 32 nmol TBA in 280 µL and either 0 or 125 nmol Pb2+, without S2−. The third sample is QD dispersion made under the nominal 32/125/65 nmol TBA/Pb/S conditions in 280 µL TAE. Do not interpret the two free-TBA controls as QD syntheses. Geometry, dimensions and colors are original conceptual presentation, not measured source apparatus.

bindings.source_locator: SI PDF p. 2–3, Figure S3 and circular dichroism method
bindings.caption: Dilute each sample to fill a 2 mL cuvette and measure with Jasco J-720. Free-TBA samples have reported Pb2+ concentrations 0 and 62 µM; retain printed 62 without replacing it by a calculated 62.5. No exact measured molecular coordinates are supplied. Geometry, dimensions and colors are original conceptual presentation, not measured source apparatus.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
